finding: Both fresh CPU runs reproduce the same sixteen initial draws and exactly the same selected configuration and heldout predictions as both original arms, while skipping eight new candidates and two model invocations per project. This is a valid objective-specific conditional shortcut, not a new scientific convergence criterion.
input_limitation: The original controller selection retained the earlier candidate on equal development loss, but the actual model rules omitted this explicit tie rule. All eight banknote hypotheses recognized the zero error floor and instead explored robustness/plateau width. Their proposed future reselection was unsupported by the actual selector; do not attribute all wasted objective-specific work to model incapability. State the real selector and tie rule before asking for more research.
scope: Post-observation targeted check after both banknote initial searches reached development error zero yet models scheduled eight further trials. Repeat the identical sixteen initial draws in fresh native projects, use the metric lower bound and strict tie-retaining selection to skip further proposals, then really refit/confirm the same selected candidate. Two known favorable cases, not a new policy benchmark or a population convergence test.
time_scope: Fresh-project setup, initial fits, explicit stop-decision capture, heldout refit and independent per-step checks are included. Preparation, manual review and packaging excluded. Compared with earlier completed A/B runs; timing is not randomized simultaneous causal evidence.
